column1: ! folds: a stride through each rule of dictionaries/folds.xfst. The expectations
! are the grammar's own answers, so a line that changes is a change to how a
! stroke folds: read it, then update it.
! A line with no tab claims the stroke has no entry: a key alone has no base.
! A function word beside a word: a and so before, then of, is and to after,
! each with its consonant off and then kept. ^A has no base, so the host skips it.
